decisions.reason: Clear two-projection distinction with contract/facade line citations: draft and occurrences in clipboardText coordinates, TokenSpan/splice in detectText with chip = one U+FFFC; ordinary text and separator space width preserved in the arithmetic.

Pins snapshot.draft.length in add, shows the rev CAS passes (fresh snapshot, idle gap) while the detect splice fails at offset 29 of a 2-char detectText, and maps the plugin's blanket false handling to the changed-composer toast; explicitly rejects a real race.

Full remove trace: unconverted clipboard-space [0,28) span, splice failure leaves the chip, ignored false plus unconditional records.delete yields the unavailable dock row; both halves tied to the coordinate misread.

Prefix-sum conversion for insertion at draft end, occurrence mapped to a one-character detect span for removal, shared helper, rev guard preserved and tested, record deletion conditioned on consumeToken success with the fallback kept clipboard-space but bypassed for the fix.

T2 two-successive-paste anchor and T7 both removal orders with a preceding chip, asserting composer occurrence, dock row and record go together while the surviving chip stays correct; T8 covers declined-consumption bookkeeping; section 5 marked unscored.
